channel.title: Songs of Praise
channel.desc: Laura Wright is in Cambridge to explore faith outside the pulpit and the pew and meets Christians living out their faith in offices, laboratories and police stations. As she explores how faith can flourish on the nine-to-five, Laura meets Ros Loaker, whose organisation facilitates faith-based workplace groups to connect and empower Christians. She then joins one such group in a Cambridge finance company and finds out the benefits of meeting with other Christians in the workplace.
